sources.description: The 2025 Jets stumbled to a 3-14 finish. After an offseason full of spending in free agency and four top 50 picks in the NFL Draft, how much higher expectations for 2026? If our most recent SB Nation Reacts poll is to be believed, not much. Last week we asked Jets fans where they expect […]
